notes: The list covers Debussy's only mature original violin work (Sonata L. 140) and the main established arrangements by Heifetz, Hartmann, Roques and Debussy himself. The only gaps I can name with some confidence are the remaining Choisnel transcriptions from the Petite suite, both medium confidence. The early Nocturne et Scherzo (1882) was omitted because I am unsure which instrument it was originally for.
